test_title: PYST 37: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 20 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: An electric pump can fill a tank in 6 hours. Due to a leakage in the tank, it takes 7½ hours to fill the tank. How much time will this leak take to empty the full tank if water does not get in or out of the tank through any other point during this period?
solution:
**Given:**

Pump fills tank in 6 hours

Pump + leak fill tank in 7½ hours = 15/2 hours

**Formula used:**

Choose total work = LCM units

Rate = Work ÷ Time

Leak rate = Pump rate − Combined rate

Time to empty = Work ÷ Leak rate

**Calculation:**

⇒ LCM of 6 and 15/2 = 30 → take total work = 30 units

⇒ Pump rate = 30 ÷ 6 = 5 units/hour

⇒ Combined rate = 30 ÷ (15/2) = 30 × 2 ÷ 15 = 4 units/hour

⇒ Leak rate = 5 − 4 = 1 unit/hour

⇒ Time taken by leak to empty full tank = 30 ÷ 1 = 30 hours

**∴ Leak will empty the full tank in 30 hours.**
